summary: Arbitral award vs high court interpretation; contract dispute on entry/toll tax reimbursement; exclusion of indirect taxes from Clause 5.1.2; price variation clauses bar individual tax adjustments; concurrent findings of tribunal/high court improperly overturned by division bench; harmonious construction principle misapplied; high court's reappreciation impermissible in appeals under Section 37 of Arbitration Act; arbitral award restored.
legal_provisions_cited: Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996 s.34, s.37
Jammu and Kashmir Levy of Toll Tax Act 1998
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Division Bench judgment set aside; Arbitral Tribunal award and Single Judge order restored.
